description: Hierarchical schematic model with one root sheet, reusable child sheet definitions, and root-level sheet instances.

root_components.description: Components physically placed on the root sheet.

sheet_definitions.description: Reusable child-sheet definitions. A single definition can be instantiated multiple times by sheet_instances.

sheet_id.description: Unique identifier for this sheet definition, referenced by sheet_instances.

file.description: KiCad child schematic file path (usually relative, e.g. 'power_stage.kicad_sch').

components.description: Components that live in this child sheet definition.

sheet_instances.description: Instances placed on the root sheet. Multiple instances may point at the same sheet definition.

instance_name.description: Unique sheet instance name on the root sheet.

pin_map.description: Optional parent-side mapping for hierarchical interface pins exposed by the child sheet.

name.description: Hierarchical pin/label name in the child sheet interface.

net.description: Parent net connected to this sheet pin.

scope.description: Label scope on the root sheet. If omitted, default is global.

refdes.description: Unique reference designator for the part, like 'U_MCU', 'R_CC1', 'C_VBUS', 'J_USB'.

LCSC.description: JLCPCB/LCSC catalog part number used to disambiguate generic manufacturer part numbers.

footprint.description: KiCad footprint identifier, e.g. 'TestPoint:TestPoint_Pad_D1.5mm'. When omitted, footprint may be inferred from library metadata.

dnp.description: If true, keep the footprint on the board but mark the symbol as Do Not Populate and exclude it from the BOM.

number.description: Pin number exactly as used by the symbol.

name.description: Pin name/label exactly as used by the symbol.

net.description: Logical net name. Use the reserved value '__NC__' to place an explicit KiCad no-connect marker on the pin.

scope.description: Connection scope. If omitted, default is global.
